 Dr Sajjan Singh Yadav assumes charge as JK’s Chief Secretary in Jammu 
 By Desk Editor 
 Published on Nov 18, 2026 
 Share 
 Convener News Desk 
 Jammu, Nov 18 : Dr Sajjan Singh Yadav, a 1995-batch IAS officer, on Wednesday assumed charge as the Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir at the Civil Secretariat in Jammu, following his transfer and appointment by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs.
 Yadav brings over three decades of administrative experience spanning public administration, financial management, health, nutrition and development policy.
 Senior administrative secretaries and other officers welcomed him upon his assumption of charge as the Union Territory’s highest-ranking civil servant.
 His appointment marks the beginning of a new administrative tenure at the helm of Jammu and Kashmir’s bureaucracy.
